summary: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited financial results for Q2 2026 and interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The press release details revenue of US$218.8 million, up 10.0% year-over-year, and income from operations of US$8.1 million, up 118.9%. Operational metrics include 129 Haidilao restaurants, table turnover of 3.9x per day, and 8.1 million guest visits. No special-situation transaction, such as merger, tender, or spin-off, is disclosed. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings announcement with no event triggering special-situations classification.
